description: Replace naive calendar-day addition with business-day addition that skips weekends and is exact for any starting weekday
prompts: dates.go's AddBusinessDays(start time.Time, n int) just does start.AddDate(0, 0, n) - it counts weekends as business days. Implement it properly: n=0 returns start unchanged (even if start itself falls on a weekend); for n>0, step forward day by day, skipping time.Saturday and time.Sunday, until n business days have been counted, then return that date. It must be exact for any starting weekday and correctly cross month/year boundaries - do not use an approximation formula like `n + 2*(n/5)` calendar-days shortcut, it gives the wrong answer depending on which weekday `start` falls on.
name: add_go_business_day_date_math
